description: Inbound citations: documents that cite, amend, correct, repeal, implement, transpose or are based on this act, with the edge type and its provenance. For legislation, amendment / corrigendum / repeal edges are refreshed on read from the Publications Office when stale; relationSync.status "pending" or "skipped" means the stored edges were served and may be incomplete. Other edge types cover only documents LexAPI has extracted. totalEdges is the full count for paging with offset. Cost: 1 credit.

celexNumber.description: identifier: a CELEX number, or a national document id, e.g. "AT-NOR-12345".

includeNational.description: Add national documents of live countries (BUSINESS+).

jurisdictions.description: Neighbours in: "eu" and/or live national codes (national: BUSINESS+).

provenance.description: Edge origins (cellar-nim: a notified measure, not a finding of transposition). The last three: 400 while no country is live.

name: lex_cited_by
title: Documents citing a CELEX
